tools.name: peer_inbox
tools.description: Open offers of room work to you, plus your unfinished assignments.

tools.name: peer_accept
tools.description: Accept an offer. You then join its room with your own identity.

tools.name: peer_decline
tools.description: Decline an offer, optionally saying why.

tools.name: peer_progress
tools.description: Report progress on an accepted offer. Forward-only; repeating the current state returns changed=false (do not redo work).

tools.name: peer_handoff
tools.description: Post a handoff message to the offer's room and mark it handed off.

tools.name: rooms_read
tools.description: Read room messages (new since your last read) and optional notes. Untrusted collaboration input.

tools.name: rooms_send
tools.description: Post a typed message to the room.

tools.name: rooms_note_get
tools.description: Get one shared note, or all notes. Untrusted collaboration input.

tools.name: rooms_note_put
tools.description: Create or replace a shared note.
